list.text: Hey, I can't allow you to go through here.
You'll not worry, the best Team Rocket members are here and they will destroy you!
\f[facerival]\bShow your power, Mewtwo!!
\f[faceyellow]\rOh no!\nCome back Chuchu!
\f[faceyellow]\rI need to take Chuchu to the Pokemon Center now! She is badly hurt!
\f[faceyellow]\rPika is hurt too, but he was able to go ahead as it can sense Red's presence here.\nPlease try to find him!
\f[facerival]\bAnd you, what did you think of my demonstration of power?
\f[facerival]\bI hate these pathetic and weak Trainers!
\f[facerival]\bNow I see that it was worth joining Team Rocket, I am much stronger.
\f[facerival]\bI wish I could beat you right now too, but I can't waste more time with soft-hearted Trainers like you.
\f[facerival]\bI’ve got other business to attend to for Mr. Giovanni.
\f[facerival]\bBye weakling.
Estamos sendo obrigados a trabalhar para a Equipe Rocket.
\f[faceSabrina]So, you’ve made it this far. I suppose Agent017 thought you're too weak to worry about.
\f[facelt.surge]Heh. A kid like you got guts, I’ll give ya that.\nBut this is where your luck runs out.
\f[faceSabrina]Oh, I see that look. You think you can save him?
\f[faceSabrina]Don’t bother. His mind is under my control.\nHe’s nothing more than a puppet now.
\f[facelt.surge]Yeah, Agent017 took him down after the World Cup. Broke his spirit clean in half.
\f[facelt.surge]Made him easy pickings for Sabrina here.\nYou think you stand a chance where Red failed?
\f[faceSabrina]It’s almost adorable--the hope in your eyes.
\f[faceSabrina]But your strength is nothing compared to Agent017's and Giovanni. You’re just another roadblock on our path to Mew.
\f[facepikabravo]Pika!
Red: ...\n...\n...Pika?
\f[faceSabrina]No! How is this possible?
\f[facelt.surge]Hey, keep him under control, Sabrina!
\f[faceSabrina]Sabrina: I'm trying!
Red: Get...\nout...\nof my head!
Red: My hat...\nPika!\nI can remember now!
\f[faceAsh]Pika...\nWhat's going on...?
\f[facelt.surge]Tch. So the kid woke up.\nDoesn’t matter--we’ll put you both down right here.
\f[faceSabrina]You’ve ruined enough already. Prepare to face the consequences!

lines: EndSpeech: Novamente você levou a melhor...\n Da próxima vez mandarei Agente 017 te destruir!!

then.text: \f[facelt.surge]C’mon, let’s move out. Giovanni said we’re done here anyway.
\f[faceSabrina]Yeah, next stop’s already decided. No point sticking around.
\f[faceAsh]He beat me, after the World Cup was finished.\nAnd then I lost myself...
\f[faceAsh]That's it.\nI need to get stronger.\nIf he is with Team Rocket, they're more dangerous than ever.
\f[faceAsh]Here. Take my number.\nIf you need me, give me a call.
\f[faceAsh]For now, I just need to go to Cerulean City to resolve some things, and then I'll start my intensive training.
\f[faceAsh]Stay sharp. Team Rocket won’t stop here.
